title: Unit 3: RAG, Embeddings & SQL Conversation Logs

lessons.title: 3. Storing AI Conversations & RAG Context in SQL
lessons.description: Store user conversations and model outputs in SQL tables for evaluation and retrieval.

tests.name: test_conversation_log
tests.unittest_code:
def test_conversation_log(self):
    log = format_conversation_log(1, 'Hello AI', 'Hello Human')
    self.assertEqual(log['user_id'], 1)
    self.assertGreater(log['tokens'], 0)
